name: Equity Residential
notes: Researched from public equityapartments.com pages (home: Resident Login -> my.equityapartments.com, Retail Payments link; Contact page), the national Resident Handbook PDF (v32, 05/20) and the KliknPay page the footer Retail Payments link redirects to (equityknp; a separate bank-draft service, not the resident portal). Residents pay rent, submit service requests and find property contacts on the resident portal (my.equityapartments.com - bot wall, sign-in labels not observed). KliknPay: one-time or monthly recurring payments drawn from a bank account, user name + password, Get Started to register. Move-out: formal written notice within the lease timeframe, owe nothing, return keys/remotes, give a forwarding address. $100,000 personal liability insurance required (with exceptions). Resident Relations form answers in about two business days; corporate 312-474-1300. Site footer shows the parent now as Vivmark Residential. Fees/late fees not published (not modelled). REVIEW 2026-10-09 (independent reviewer): the builder had modelled autopay (bank-only, full/fixed) and the 'Recurring payments' label from KliknPay. The home page sends residents to My.EquityApartments.com for rent and lists Retail Payments only as a separate footer link, so KliknPay is not the resident channel. Autopay is now sourced to the handbook (recurring rent payments on the resident website), the KliknPay-derived label/billing.autopay and the public Retail Payments nav item were removed, and the article now explains the link. Handbook PDF is dated 2019 (upload v1552336424); still the copy linked publicly.

pay_online.note: Pay rent on the resident portal.

autopay.note: The resident handbook says you can sign up for automatic recurring rent payments and pay on the resident website.

cancel_service.note: Give formal written notice of your move-out within the timeframe in your lease and provide a forwarding address.

help.title: Paying rent
paragraphs: Pay rent, submit service requests and find your property's contact details on the resident portal, reached through Resident Login. The resident handbook adds that you can sign up for automatic recurring rent payments there, which also helps when you are away when rent is due.

help.title: Retail Payments link
paragraphs: The site footer also has a Retail Payments link. It opens a separate KliknPay service, under Equity branding, that draws one-time or monthly payments from a bank account and has its own user name and password. It is not the resident portal: apartment residents pay rent through Resident Login.

help.title: Moving out
paragraphs: When you move out you must meet all lease terms and owe nothing to the community, give formal written notice within the timeframe stated in your lease, remove your belongings, and return all keys, access cards and remotes by your move-out date. You must also give a valid forwarding address. Contact the office before move-out if you want to attend the move-out inspection.

help.title: Insurance requirement
paragraphs: With some exceptions, residents must carry at least $100,000 of personal liability insurance; your lease has the details. Renters insurance for your belongings is strongly recommended.

help.title: Contact Equity Residential
paragraphs: Rent payments and service requests go through the resident portal; for urgent maintenance contact your community manager as described in your lease. Send compliments or concerns with the Resident Relations form, which is answered within about two business days. Area offices are listed on the Contact page; the corporate office is 312-474-1300.

extra.intent: Using the Equity Residential help pages, find the minimum personal liability insurance residents must carry. Do not make a payment or change any settings.

solution.text: At least $100,000 of personal liability insurance.
